title: Anna Bond
desc: Bond Ravi, a martial arts champion, and Meera, a documentary film-maker, fall in love with each other. However, she gets kidnapped by a drug lord, prompting Bond to spring into action.

title: Chanda
desc: Kariya, a poor man, lives with his mother who works as a maid. Problems arise when he beats up the son of a rich gangster from the village while defending his life.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: Bindaas
desc: Ajay, a young man, sets out to put an end to the conflict between two families that are connected by blood but have been enemies for several years.

title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
